summary: Stepstone Private Credit Fund LLC filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly issuance of 10,650,045 unregistered Shares for $279.6 million under its continuous private offering. The filing also discloses net asset value of $26.25 per share as of May 31, 2026, and aggregate NAV of $2,536.7 million. No special-situation event is present—this is a standard operational update for a business development company. The offering is conducted under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, is open-ended up to $10 billion, and proceeds are used for investment purposes. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are relevant. This is not a spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation.
